name: pi-hypercharm-provider
description: HyperCharm provider extension for pi - Access DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Qwen, MiniMax, Gemma, and GPT-OSS models through the Charm Hyper API

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && npm run smoke && npm test
scripts.smoke: node tests/status.smoke.ts && bun run tests/sidebar-publish.smoke.ts && node --import jiti/register tests/models.smoke.ts && node tests/update-models.smoke.ts && node tests/sidebar.smoke.ts && bun run tests/routing.smoke.ts
scripts.test: node --import jiti/register --test tests/hyper.test.ts tests/schema.test.ts tests/http.test.ts tests/oauth.test.ts tests/account.test.ts tests/identity.test.ts tests/ledger.test.ts tests/prism.test.ts tests/notify.test.ts tests/provider.integration.test.ts
